ranking_semantics: Rank reflects present evidence and decision relevance, not a posterior causal probability. Observed distribution difference is not an accepted scientific Model Discrepancy verdict.

mechanisms.mechanism: Joint gap/closing-speed organization and longitudinal dynamic response
mechanisms.observation: Source gap-positive-closing Spearman 0.095/0.124 in NGSIM versus 0.527/0.480 in B00/Round2. Candidate source gap p05=3.370m is below real 4.916/4.392m, but no source TTC<2 state. Within v<5mps positive-closing p95 is 2.804/2.444 real versus 0.750/0.890 simulation.
mechanisms.support: Missing small-gap/large-positive-closing combinations remain visible in common macro cells; pure minimum-gap shortage and event-duration-only explanation are weakened. Historical 324 replay results also show conditional-response error.
mechanisms.counterevidence: No intervention separates model response from leader-input fluctuation, lane-change timing, composition or measurement error.
mechanisms.identification: Joint support difference Verified; safe-speed/dynamic-response causal mechanism remains Hypothesis.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: After independent quality adjudication, compare predeclared stable-leader source-event response histories against matched nonrisk support; if intervention is still needed, researcher must separately authorize fixed leader-input paired response test without changing topology/arrivals/cohort at the same time.

mechanisms.observation: At +/-2s, any observed transition in 27/167 and 33/159 source events, versus 2/165 and 5/149 controls. Complete two-role histories without observed transition still cover 122 and 114 source events. SUMO source near-TTC segments include lane-entry signatures in 3/4 and 2/3 segments.
mechanisms.support: Lateral/leader changes are associated with a subset of real events and the simulated near tail.
mechanisms.counterevidence: A missing-lane-change-only explanation cannot account for the majority of observed real source events; source auxiliary-to-mainline witnesses are zero, with censored context retained.
mechanisms.identification: Descriptive association Verified; causal cut-in/merge attribution Unknown.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: Audit already reconstructed switched-leader histories and any available independent lane/identity evidence; no new five-vehicle identities or ramp route inferred.

mechanisms.observation: Real source same-pair gap-derivative residual p99=0.546/0.492mps versus 0.140/0.140 simulation. Event-context median residuals are similar to their controls, and event-minimum TTC medians remain 1.387/1.325s despite extreme minima near zero.
mechanisms.support: Extreme risk severity and some dynamic tails require independent physical validation; formal identity/continuity qualification is insufficient for physical truth.
mechanisms.counterevidence: Residual medians do not show a simple event-only error regime. No independent reference allows quantifying artifact fraction.
mechanisms.identification: Residuals Verified; fraction of apparent risks caused by errors Unknown.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: Researcher-authorized finite source-event physical review against independent video/reference, stratified by severity and continuity; retain official event inventory and publish adjudication separately.

mechanisms.support: Existing arrival-timing study reports upstream wave support in real data and failure to consistently restore it in historical simulations; lane-drop structure changed both micro tails and macro state.
mechanisms.counterevidence: Historical runs use different regions/windows/configurations. Current B00/Round2 wave mismatch and event-specific propagation were not newly established. Arrival timing alone already failed as a sufficient explanation.
mechanisms.identification: Historical evidence reusable; current causal attribution Unknown.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: Use existing time-block and leader histories to specify a single disturbance-input contrast only if a later authorized test is indispensable; do not redesign roads now.

mechanisms.support: Observed follower-level gap/closing/TTC medians vary widely, and earlier selected-pair effects do not generalize to the full population.
mechanisms.counterevidence: Current SUMO already has five tau vTypes; observed spread also reflects traffic state and exposure. No driver preference is identified by these medians.
mechanisms.identification: Population variation Verified; missing behavioral heterogeneity as root cause Unknown.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: Condition the existing response histories on leader input and traffic state before discussing any new heterogeneous parameter scheme.

mechanisms.support: Real windows are 952.9/999.1s descriptive support versus 270s evaluation; actual source followers 2031/1889 versus 566/598. SUMO observed declared class is passenger with one 4.4196m length; real follower class/length absent from authorized canonical schema.
mechanisms.counterevidence: Source point-tail differences persist inside shared coarse density/speed cells. Different means or observation length alone is not a sufficient account.
mechanisms.identification: Scope differences Verified; their contribution cannot be partitioned quantitatively.
mechanisms.minimal_discriminator: Keep separate windows and population weights; request additional metadata authorization only if class/time resolution is scientifically necessary.

new_experiment_necessity.needed_to_identify_unique_cause: Unknown; independent measurement validation precedes a decision about intervention

recommendation: Retain the fixed source as an observed event-support object for researcher review, prioritize finite independent physical-quality adjudication of source events, then decide whether one isolated dynamic-response experiment is justified. No parameter/model candidate is selected.
